biotools.summary: Searchable database of peptide research. It lists results reported in published studies, each with the exact source quote, and links them to papers and to registered clinical trials. Covers peptides, blends and related compounds. Results are extracted by an AI model and checked by software and a second AI model. Each result carries an evidence class: human, animal, laboratory or predicted. Free to use without login, with a REST API and an MCP server.
